scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the modified heat capacity from the fixed parameters using generalized Debye functions and compares the resulting deviation against the paper’s Table 2 gold deviations at integer temperatures 50–200 K; also executes structural comparisons on the agent’s reported deviations to verify that the modified model outperforms Debye and Tarasov.

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental cV (cal/mol·K) and modified model deviation (%) from paper Table 2 for temperatures 50–200 K used as gold for recompute comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, columns 2 and 5 (Abweichungen Spalte 2‑3 in %) for T = 50, 60, …, 200 K.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the published paper (Kolloid‑Z. u. Z. Polymere 241, 1057‑1070, 1970) with verification against the paper’s in‑table values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper’s own reported experimental data and deviation; they are the only independent hidden reference for the modified model’s quality.

outputs.description: The CSV contains the experimental c_V values and the computed c_Vs plus absolute percentage deviations for the Debye, Tarasov, and modified models over the temperature range 1–200 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported deviation values (especially the modified model deviations) against hidden gold from the paper’s Table 2 using a threshold_or_better policy, and will also check structural relationships (e.g., that the modified model outperforms Debye and Tarasov).
